So its the last unit of the year and I am teaching the last unit of Oregon Trail. And I want the students to live the trail. Thats how I taught third grade, I would create a world and then run a game and uh um the worlds were pretty goofy. Lik we got an animal rock band named Antic Lea and the Howlers who got lost and we had to help the. Once we got letters from a time machine. it was a complicated time and i dont think students can understand their little sisters perspective let alone pioneers and westward expansion. 
One student asked if it was going to be dangerous and I said yeah because its a simulation. The game was made with rules like dungeons and dragons, you know the dice game. So we picked names and then played the game and one student said could we die and i wanted to knock them down a  peg so i said yes. and we had weird names like alex bacon and one time I ran into a student on broadway who looked the same but stretched out you know and she said remember when we almost died on the oregon trail and I said yes.
